Dated this the 5th day of November, 2025 The application is filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short, 'BNSS'), by the sole accused in Crime No.1994/2023 of the Venjaramoodu Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram, which is registered against him, for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)
(h), 376(2)(n), 376(3) and 450 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4(2) r/w Section 3(a), Section 6 r/w Section 5(j)(ii), Section 5(l), Section 5(q), Section 8 r/w Section 7, Section 10 r/w Section 9(l)
and Section 9(q) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
2.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
When the bail application came up for consideration on 23.08.2024, this Court, taking note of the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case, that the petitioner was in judicial custody for 80 days,
that the investigation in the case was completed and the final 2025:KER:83813 report was laid

,
enlarged the petitioner on interim bail.
The said order was extended from time to time on the specific undertaking made by the petitioner that he would marry the victim on her attaining majority on 17.09.2025.
3. I have heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Senior Public Prosecutor.
4. The petitioner has produced Annexure A2 marriage certificate, which shows that the petitioner got married to the victim on 23.09.2025.
5. The learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor submit that the petitioner and the victim are now happily residing together.
Moreover, the final report has already been laid, and the case has now been scheduled for trial.
6.Taking into consideration the above facts, I am of the firm view that the application is only to be allowed by making the interim order dated 23.08.2024 absolute.
In the result, the bail application is allowed by making the interim order dated 23.08.2024 absolute.
The petitioner shall adhere to the conditions in the interim order and appear before the Trial Court as and when directed.

Sd/-
